decisions.reason: The updated design concerns the PowerPoint deliverable and does not change the independently specified graphic-bullet appearance in the Word templates.
The source updates the design source for the PowerPoint template but does not change the contents, version designation, or archive format of the versioned Word-template package.
An updated PowerPoint design does not alter the required style source, additions, or coverage across the Word templates.
The PowerPoint design update does not change the required legacy-to-new copy-paste behavior for Word templates.
The source does not address or change paragraph, Enter-key, or line-break behavior in the Word templates.
The source identifies an updated PowerPoint design but does not specify any change to the approved Word-template theme colors or color availability policy.
The PowerPoint design update has no entailed effect on Tab-controlled list levels or hierarchy behavior in Word.
The source does not change the requirement that Word tables and columns remain within page bounds during pasted-content workflows.
Although the client asks for a quick budget check on the updated PowerPoint design, this does not modify the earlier task-local due-diligence assessment of the Word templates.
The source does not address or alter internal text spacing in the Word-template layouts.
The updated PowerPoint design does not affect the established row-extension workflow in the Board Meeting Word template.
The source does not change the fixed-margin and clipping-prevention behavior required for the Vejledning Word template.
